title: hostResourceLimits
responsibility: Reads hierarchical Linux cgroup-v2 CPU and memory quotas without treating host capacity as container capacity.

inputs.name: hostResourceLimits.root
inputs.description: Linux cgroup-v2 filesystem root, replaceable by a fixture directory.

inputs.name: hostResourceLimits.membership
inputs.description: Proc cgroup membership file identifying this process namespace.

inputs.name: hostResourceLimits.system
inputs.description: Operating system identifier; non-Linux systems have no cgroup limits.

outputs.name: hostResourceLimits
outputs.description: Tightest applicable CPU quota, quota usage and memory limits; empty outside Linux.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Missing cgroup-v2 support, unsafe membership paths, malformed quotas or unreadable diagnostics reject.
